content:
On last screenshot you can see article from United States magazine Aviation Week from 1955 which talks about Avro Flying Saucer which use Coanda effect.

The article (titled something along the lines of a special report on the "Avro Saucer" project, with the USAF confirmation of development work on a disc-shaped flying aircraft) appears on pages 14–15. 

It includes details about the USAF's involvement, the Coanda effect, nuclear powerplant considerations for future flight tests by 1958, and references to Avro's work under John Frost (though the main focus is the broader "flying saucer" concept tied to Avro-like designs).
